storyCards.headline: When Love Comes To Town: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
U2's "When Love Comes To Town" reached #68 on the Billboard Hot 100. "When Love Comes to Town" is a song by Irish rock band U2 featuring American blues guitarist B.

It is the twelfth track from U2's 1988 album, Rattle and Hum, and was released in 1989 as the record's third single.

The song was recorded at the historic Sun Studio in Memphis.

The song peaked at #68 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #68 on the Hot 100.
